- Would contain SHA1 hash of ransom.exe

- Records file size, version information if present
- Includes full path and potentially the original filename if renamed
- May show associated PE header information like compilation timestamp
- In Amcache.hve, look for entries in Registry keys like Root\File\{volume GUID}\

- Execution from user-writable directories (Downloads, Temp, AppData)
- Recent timestamps correlating with encryption activity
- Multiple related executables with similar timestamps
